definitions.providerCalls: Invocations of the real modal row provider during the measured update window.
definitions.driveAttempts: Calls from real components.js into real ui.js _drive methods during the measured update window, including cache-suppressed calls.
definitions.engineAttempts: Calls during the measured update window that passed ui.js diffing and reached a resolved engine/native stub.
definitions.submittedWrites: Successful mutating calls accepted by that stub during the measured update window; failures are not injected, so this equals engineAttempts.
definitions.queuePeak: Actual components.js dirty-record queue length after intents and before the candidate frame drain.
definitions.cleanupQueue: Actual dirty-record queue length after closing every measured modal.
